plan.yaml: Hand-copied from the retired guide fixture plan.yaml (git history, commit 4a5a7d2, contracts/preparation/guide/testdata), which was hand-authored from ADR 0340: three directory contacts, one team, one inactive section, and no resultsPath, so the ADR 0210 default records/{account}/ layout applies.
plan-people.yaml: ADR 0210: a token may fill part of a directory component and directories may nest, so the preparation sits beside the record at people/person-{account}/notes/.
plan-flat.yaml: ADR 0210 and the locator contract: an account only in the filename cannot isolate a preparation; the locator rejects the path.
plan-no-id.yaml: ADR 0340 and the retired guide contract: a missing plan ID cannot supply person-specific identity.
plan-twice.yaml: ADR 0210: repeated placeholders are allowed and all are replaced; the preparation sibling keeps its fixed name.
plan-pair.yaml: ADR 0210: every token in a path is replaced by the same account, here twice inside one directory component.
identity.yaml: Retired guide fixture identity.yaml (commit 4a5a7d2): ADR 0340 absent identity-only create. Four required fields in the order of the example in docs/reference/preparation-format.md.
named.yaml: Retired guide fixture named.yaml (commit 4a5a7d2): ADR 0340 explicit recipient save. Hand-written, not encoder output.
literal.yaml: Retired guide fixture literal.yaml (commit 4a5a7d2): ADR 0340 literal terminal controls and ADR 0200 Unicode separators retained as data. The bytes are written back unchanged, so they must survive a save exactly.
noop-empty.yaml: Retired guide fixture noop-empty.yaml (commit 4a5a7d2): ADR 0340 says a decoder-accepted empty arrangement is unencodable but an unchanged review must still be a byte-preserving no-op.
arrangements-held.yaml: Retired guide fixture arrangements-before.yaml (commit 4a5a7d2): ADR 0350 held arrangements with ordered repeated helpers, a multiline note, stale references, and the unknown root key x-retained that must survive.
arrangements-held-edited.yaml: Hand-edited copy of arrangements-held.yaml where only the recipient name changed: the reviewed bytes for a save that keeps arrangements and unknown data. Written by hand, not by an encoder.
reordered.yaml: Stated rule in the contract: a held file that means the same as identity.yaml but has a comment and a different key order. A draft equal in meaning is an unchanged draft, and the original bytes stay.
replaced.yaml: Hand-written second recipient name used as a different reviewed document, to show a second save is refused after the first.
replaced-reordered.yaml: Hand-written reviewed document with a comment and keys out of encoder order. The store writes reviewed bytes exactly as given, so these bytes must appear on disk unchanged.
other-account.yaml: ADR 0340: a preparation for another account is an identity failure at load and a draft failure at save.
other-plan.yaml: ADR 0340: a preparation for another plan is an identity failure at load and a draft failure at save.
lower-account.yaml: ADR 0340: a preparation for another account is an identity failure at load and a draft failure at save. The account earlier sorts below the requested account newcomer, so a check that only refuses accounts that sort above it fails.
lower-plan.yaml: ADR 0340: a preparation for another plan is an identity failure at load and a draft failure at save. The plan ID planlow sorts below the plan ID planone, so a check that only refuses plan IDs that sort above it fails.
wrong-kind.yaml: ADR 0340: wrong kind refuses; the preparation decoder reports kind problems.
malformed.yaml: ADR 0220: input must decode through the real decoder. An unclosed flow sequence is not YAML.
invalid-utf8.yaml: ADR 0220 bounded UTF-8 input rule. Bytes 0xff 0xfe are not UTF-8.
cases.json: Each list case cites its own source in its source field.
